about: Neon Rain's modules (docs/ROADMAP.md 3.3): one per concern, each with its purpose, what it may import of ours, and what it must not. test/test_modules.py holds every import under neonrain/ to this file. entryPoints are filled as each module is built.
package: Each module is the package neonrain.<module>; the module of an import is the segment after neonrain.
adding: To add a module: one entry here with every field; its folder appears with its first code. A module may import only what its mayImport lists. A new module or a new import is an architecture decision (theGhost.md): draft the entry and the docs/ROADMAP.md 3.3 line as a proposal, say you are waiting on Ghost, and stop; do not add it to main. A new file inside an existing module, and its entry in that module's entryPoints, is an agent's to add; only a new module or a new import between modules waits on Ghost (J-025). If you cannot tell whether the person asking is Ghost, say so and propose.

rules.rule: Only scorer imports a model client (anthropic or any other).
harness never imports models, baselines or training: the referee does not read the players' code.
No module imports a broker, exchange or order client.
features reads the news ledger only through ledger's cut reader, never the parquet directly.
Nothing but scripts/fetch and the forward test reads the clock.
models imports nothing of ours, and only training imports models: the network can be lifted out, one way.

universe.purpose: Which tickers exist on which dates; delistings where known; the trading calendar.

features.purpose: The feature table per ticker per day: price-derived, indicator, news.

targets.purpose: The four horizons' labels: direction and rank (R-004).

harness.purpose: Splits (time x group), cost model, metrics, the trials file; frozen after phase 1 (R-002).

models.purpose: The one network (R-009), liftable one way (R-025): given a feature table, scores; it imports nothing of ours.

training.purpose: Trains the network and runs it through the harness (R-025); the only module that imports models.

scorer.purpose: The pinned Haiku scorer and the news-ledger writer; the only module with a model client (R-008).

ledger.purpose: Readers for the news and prediction ledgers, with the publish-time cut.
